householder.title: Original observation coordinates
householder.why: The column spans a line. Its coefficient is eleven twenty-fifths; its squared distance to the data is four twenty-fifths.

householder.title: Construct the reflector normal
householder.why: With α = −5, use u = v + 5e₁ = (8,4). The sign avoids cancellation in the leading coordinate.

householder.title: Reflect both the design and the data
householder.why: H is orthogonal. Both vectors must be transformed; their residual length is preserved.

householder.title: Separate fitted and residual coordinates
householder.why: The first coordinate is fitted exactly. The vertical remaining coordinate is two-fifths, giving squared error four twenty-fifths.

leverage.title: Full three-point fit
leverage.why: An outlined point was omitted from fitting but is still predicted. Its vertical error is a deleted-observation error, not its original training residual.

leverage.title: Delete the middle observation

sensitivity.title: Column separation ε = 1
sensitivity.why: Only the second observed response changes by one-hundredth. Fitted change remains (0,1/100,0), while canceling coefficients can grow large as the columns become dependent.
